propositions: Agents file bugs outside epic hierarchy during execution that should block close if they are defects in the epic's own deliverable, but the direct-children gate cannot detect them.

A deterministic caused_by floor must block epic close when any open or in-progress bug has a caused_by edge pointing to the epic or its descendants, with a teaching message to fix, re-parent, or dispute the link.

The candidate filter must identify open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first in_progress transition or linked to the epic subtree (any relation, both directions), capped at 32 with overflow recorded.

A single-turn haiku relevance screen must classify candidates as defect-in-deliverable (A), pre-existing/adjacent (B), or unrelated (C), with results forwarded as compact evidence to the verifier through the precheck-assembled context.
The verifier must block only undispositioned deliverable-defects, where disposition satisfies via supersedes/duplicates links or reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose in store, never via close_class.
Screen tally including per-candidate verdicts and unevaluated-overflow count must record to the completion sidecar; screen failure degrades open with logged reason, never blocks close by itself.
